h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dewas

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dewas

items.pText: Dewas sits on the Malwa plateau next to Indore, and its industrial areas have brought staff colonies, schools and new housing to the town. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment to these buyers from our factory in Vasai, about 520 km away. Every piece is designed and made in-house, then sent by road to Madhya Pradesh.

Many Dewas projects begin with a modest budget and a large open plot. A factory colony or a school does not need to fill the whole ground at once. We often plan the layout in two stages: a swing set, a slide and a see-saw now, with space kept free for a multi play system later. The layout drawing shows both stages, so the first pieces sit where they will still make sense when the rest arrives.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Black soil and foundations in Dewas

c: Much of the Malwa region has black cotton soil, which swells when it is wet and cracks as it dries. Posts set straight into this soil can tilt after a few monsoons. For open ground we suggest grouting the equipment on a proper concrete base, or laying a firm sub-base under a self-standing installation. Tell us about the soil on your site, or send a photo of a dug pit, and we will plan the foundation with you.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can we buy playground equipment in stages?
items.a: Yes. We can draw the full layout first and supply part of it now. The remaining pieces can be ordered later and placed in the spaces already marked on the drawing.

items.q: Do you supply schools and factory colonies around Dewas and Indore?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai to sites across Madhya Pradesh and install the equipment through our own team or a local dealer.

items.q: How do you install equipment on black cotton soil?
items.a: We usually grout the posts on a concrete base so that movement in the soil does not tilt them. On a firm paved area, a self-standing installation may be enough.
